name: tlc-trace-0
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC, TLCExt
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
Next == x' \in {x, (x + 1) % 2}
Bound == PrintT(<<"constraint", x, Trace>>)
ActionBound == PrintT(<<"action", x, x', Trace>>)
Inv == PrintT(<<"invariant", x, Trace>>)
Prop == [][PrintT(<<"property", x, x', Trace, Trace'>>)]_x
====
config: INIT Init NEXT Next CONSTRAINT Bound ACTION_CONSTRAINT ActionBound INVARIANT Inv CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
